title: Oracle CRM Technical Consultant - Muscat, Oman
description:
Alfalogic recruits Oracle CRM (EBS R12) Technical Consultant with 5 to 8 years of relevant experience with customization of CRM module for Third-Party application Billing Application. The candidates who are selected for the project should be able to join in 15 days and relocate to Muscat , Oman. 
 Key Responsibilities Understanding the existing setups and processes Resolving functional and technical errors/bugs encountered in the existing setup Fixing errors/bugs which will be encountered while using customized forms, reports Providing On-site support to users when required in case of difficulty in the usage of the software. Providing support to users in case of corruption in the software to get back to normal situation. Support by Techno/Functional Consultant for any changes required in Application functionality and features. Application Changing, Problem solving, bug reporting, documentation clarification and technical guidance related to Application software. Give MM Users an application training whenever needed Designing solution for new services Provision of the recommended solution for implementing new services or facing any issue based on their experience and best practice. Co-ordination with other consultants (e.i. java consultant, DBA, etc ) when required. Performing unit testing and process related testing on upgraded environment Attend all meetings with MM team and with other Bidders as required Developing Oracle forms, reports (XML Publisher), database objects and the customizations within the implementation Developing new web services and modifying the exciting. Applying the personalization needed in the standard Oracle Forms Applying full testing on the customized solution should have experience in Oracle Receivable Module Coordinating with Oracle Metalink website for TAR and Web Conference supports for any Oracle CRM and Revenue related issues Responsible for any data migration required by Muscat Municipality Will be part of project team member for development of business scenarios and test cases for UAT of upgraded system Will do any updates related to upgrading to new releases Helping the Java Technical Consultant writing PL/SQL statement and provide him with any information may need Knowledge transfer will be carried out during the support period to MM Team Provide 7x24 support when required 

 The candidates who are interested and able to join in short notice can share their profile if you are comfortable with the above Job Description .

Key Skills: Technical Consultant,Oracle,CRM,R12,Oracle E-Business Suite,EBS,Oracle EBS Technical,E Business Suite
